Rao Kanhadev becomes Rathore ruler of Marwar (part of modern-day India).
Kshetra Singh becomes Maharana of Mewar
Rana Kshetra Singh succeeds Rana Hamir Singh, as ruler of Mewar (part of modern-day western India).
In modern-day southern India, Bahmani Sultan Mohammed Shah I invades the Vijayanagara Empire.
Rao Biram Dev succeeds Rao Kanhadev as ruler of Marwar (the modern-day Jodhpur district of India).
Rana Lakha becomes Maharana of Mewar
Rana Lakha succeeds Rana Kshetra Singh, as ruler of Mewar (now part of western India).
Rao Chanda succeeds Rao Biram Dev as Rathore ruler of Marwar (in modern-day western India).
